## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-2 (3136): the same brainstorm run writes a ## Copy Needs section into the epic description that passes the schema validator
- dd-3 (3136): each Copy Needs item written by brainstorm carries stable_id, type, location, page, and validation rule populated

## Description
Extend brainstorm Phase 1.5 to: when copy-needed tag is applied, write a `## Copy Needs` section into the epic description conforming to plugins/dso/docs/contracts/copy-needs-section.md (placeholder reference — schema created in story b6cd). Each item carries stable_id (kebab-case unique per epic), type (label/hint/error/button), location (file path or component name), page (controlled vocabulary identifier), and validation rule (free text).

The user confirms each item during dialogue before it's written to the description. Re-running brainstorm on an epic that already has Copy Needs does NOT duplicate items (idempotent on stable_id).

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given a synthetic epic with UI-copy signals and a fixture user-input stream confirming Copy Needs items; When brainstorm Phase 1.5 runs to completion; Then the epic description contains a ## Copy Needs section, each item carries stable_id+type+location+page+validation rule, AND the section passes the schema validator. Re-running brainstorm on the same epic leaves the section unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] brainstorm SKILL.md documents Copy Needs section writing
  Verify: grep -qE '## Copy Needs' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
- [ ] Test asserts section is written and validates against schema
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-brainstorm-copy-needs-writer.sh
- [ ] Test asserts idempotency on re-run
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-brainstorm-copy-needs-writer.sh test_idempotent_rerun
- [ ] Test registered in .test-index
  Verify: grep -q 'test-brainstorm-copy-needs-writer.sh' plugins/dso/tests/.test-index

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
| plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md | Edit |
| plugins/dso/tests/test-brainstorm-copy-needs-writer.sh | Create |
| plugins/dso/tests/.test-index | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate to opus then user
data.title: Write Copy Needs section into epic description on positive detection
